mods.name: BepInEx Configuration Manager
mods.author: BepInEx team
mods.desc: Press F1 in the game to change the settings of your mods without editing files.

mods.name: Blueprinter
mods.author: Nikkorap
mods.desc: Loads aircraft, weapons and vehicles that other people made. Most add-on aircraft need it.

mods.name: Runtime Unity Editor
mods.author: ManlyMarco
mods.desc: Inspect and change game objects while the game runs. For mod makers.

mods.name: Nuclear Minimap
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Shows the map on a cockpit screen, with heading tape, zoom keys and north-up or heading-up.

mods.name: Nuclear Delivery
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Counts your missiles and bombs in flight and shows hits and misses on the target camera.

mods.name: Nuclear Spectator
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Watch other pilots from their cockpit, with their HUD, a target camera and smooth camera moves.

mods.name: Nuclear Map Trails
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Draws fading trails behind aircraft on the map.

mods.name: Nuclear Map Markings
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Runways, approach lines, range rings and predicted paths on the map.

mods.name: Nuclear Satellite Map
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Satellite pictures under the map grid. Large download: the map images are 127 MB.

mods.name: Nuclear Night Vision
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Night vision fades in and out instead of switching at once.

mods.name: Nuclear Sounds
mods.author: dikka
mods.desc: Extra cockpit warning sounds and a quieter missile warning.

mods.name: F-27 Harrier Kai
mods.author: Sable
mods.desc: A rank 2 vertical take-off strike jet with a new cockpit.

mods.name: Su-41 Vortex
mods.author: Okapi
mods.desc: A fast rank 4 interceptor for the PALA side with long-range missiles.

mods.name: A-9 Warthog II
mods.author: Sable
mods.desc: A slow, tough ground-attack aircraft with a 30 mm gun.

mods.name: Coastal Strike Pack
mods.author: Okapi
mods.desc: Six anti-ship missiles and two glide bombs for add-on aircraft.

mods.name: Tower Voice Pack
mods.author: Halcyon
mods.desc: New recorded voices for the tower and for ground crews.

mods.name: Better Flares
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: Brighter flares with smoke that stays in the air a little longer.

mods.name: Cockpit Shake
mods.author: Voss
mods.desc: The cockpit shakes with speed, G-load and gun fire.

mods.name: FFB Tuner
mods.author: pilot_ray
mods.desc: Change force-feedback strength for each aircraft, with a test page.

mods.name: Radio Chatter
mods.author: Halcyon
mods.desc: Background radio calls from other flights during missions.

mods.name: Deutsche Lokalisierung
mods.author: Voss
mods.desc: German texts for menus, the HUD and the encyclopedia.

mods.name: Free Camera Plus
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: More camera modes for screenshots: orbit, fly-by and a fixed tower camera.

mods.name: Server Tools
mods.author: Mako
mods.desc: Admin commands, vote kicks and mission rotation for dedicated servers.

mods.name: Loadout Presets
mods.author: pilot_ray
mods.desc: Save a weapon loadout and use it again with one click.

mods.name: Target Box Colors
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: Choose the colours of target boxes for friends, enemies and unknown contacts.

mods.name: Autopilot Hold
mods.author: Okapi
mods.desc: Holds altitude, heading or speed until you touch the stick.

mods.name: Carrier Ops
mods.author: Mako
mods.desc: Adds catapult launches and arrested landings on carriers.

mods.name: Desert Dawn Terrain
mods.author: Halcyon
mods.desc: A dry desert look for the Heartland map, with new ground textures.

mods.name: Sonic Boom
mods.author: Voss
mods.desc: You hear a boom when a supersonic aircraft passes.

mods.name: HUD Scale
mods.author: pilot_ray
mods.desc: Make the HUD larger or smaller, for wide screens and 4K.

mods.name: Mission Timer
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: A small clock that shows how long the mission has run.

mods.name: Wingman Commands
mods.author: Mako
mods.desc: Give orders to AI wingmen: attack my target, cover me, return to base.

mods.name: Head Tracking Recenter
mods.author: pilot_ray
mods.desc: One key recenters your head tracker and a second key pauses it.

mods.name: VR Hands
mods.author: Okapi
mods.desc: Shows your hands in VR and lets you press cockpit buttons.

mods.name: Tracer Colors
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: Different tracer colours for each side.

mods.name: Kill Feed Filter
mods.author: Mako
mods.desc: Hide or shorten kill messages on busy servers.

mods.name: Fuel Planner
mods.author: Halcyon
mods.desc: Shows how far you can fly with your fuel and when you must turn back.

mods.name: G-Meter
mods.author: Voss
mods.desc: A G-load number next to the speed tape.

mods.name: Smoke Trails
mods.author: tern
mods.desc: Coloured display smoke for formation flights.

mods.name: AWACS Callouts
mods.author: Halcyon
mods.desc: A voice tells you bearing and range of new threats.

mods.name: TestHud
mods.author: TestHud.dll
mods.desc: You added this mod from a file. It is not in the registry, so NNOMM cannot look for updates.

mods.name: Squadron Skins
mods.author: squadron-skins.zip
mods.desc: You added this mod from a file. It is not in the registry, so NNOMM cannot look for updates.

minimap: The HUD no longer stays on screen after you are shot down.
The cockpit map keeps its place when a map icon is removed.
Fixed the map jumping to the bottom-left corner.
Zoom keys now use one binding system for keyboard, gamepad and HOTAS.
harrier-kai: Hover is more stable below 40 knots.
loadout-presets: Presets can be shared as a short code.
Fixed presets for aircraft with internal bays.

settings.label: Start options
settings.help: Extra options for the game, for example -screen-fullscreen 0.

settings.label: Mod loader
settings.help: BepInEx 5.4.23.4, installed by NNOMM. Mods cannot run without it. NNOMM installs it when you turn on your first mod, and tells you.

settings.label: Show the mod log window while the game runs
settings.help: A text window with messages from mods. Useful when a mod fails.

settings.label: Read the registry for new mods and updates
options: Every hour while NNOMM is open

settings.label: When a mod has an update
Offer test versions of mods
settings.help: Authors mark some versions as pre-release. They can be unstable.

settings.label: Keep the version before an update
settings.help: You can go back to it from the mod page.

settings.label: Install mods that a mod needs
settings.help: For example Blueprinter for add-on aircraft.

settings.label: Mark mods made for an older game version
settings.help: A mark is not proof that the mod is broken.

settings.label: Show profiles in the sidebar
settings.help: With this off NNOMM uses the Default profile and you have one mod list.

settings.label: New profiles keep their own mod settings
settings.help: Mod settings are the values you change with F1 in the game. With this off all profiles share them.

settings.label: A new profile starts
options: As a copy of the current profile

settings.label: This profile keeps its own mod settings
Registries
settings.help: NNOMM reads the mods you can install from these addresses.

settings.label: Hide mods that are only for servers
Show Servers in the sidebar
settings.help: Turn this off if you do not use the server list.

settings.label: Where NNOMM keeps mod files
settings.help: Each version of a mod is stored once here, also when several profiles use it. 438 MB used.

settings.label: Downloaded files that are no longer in use
settings.help: 212 MB. Old versions that no profile uses.

settings.label: Update NNOMM
settings.help: Version 0.1.0. You have the newest version.

settings.label: Problem report
settings.help: A report with your mod list, versions and the last game log. NNOMM shows it to you before you send it to anyone.

settings.label: About
settings.help: NNOMM is a fork of NOMM by Combat787 (MIT licence). The mod list is NOMNOM by KopterBuzz.

settings.label: Remove all mods
settings.help: Mods that can be downloaded again leave every profile. Other mods stay in the Library, turned off, with their stored copies kept. Only loader files NNOMM installed are removed. An adopted loader, your own files, profiles and recovery copies stay.

keys: Turn the mod on or off
